officialPrimarySources.observation: Official municipal home links a separate Catastro Web viewer. The linked public app shell at catastroweb.cusco.gob.pe is anonymous, but its checked JavaScript is an Angular municipal service application, includes a login route, and exposed no parcel schema or safe full-geometry endpoint. The distinct PUCCU “cadastral viewer” is limited to stormwater infrastructure, not cadastral parcels.

Anonymous landing application only; page scripts are main/runtime/polyfills. Static main bundle has no parcel/cadastral geometry API route (the only `/api/` route identified is panic alerts) and includes a login component. No login/API submission.
Official public cadastral-labelled viewer is for stormwater drainage infrastructure; not evidence of property parcel geometry.
Official city source documents urban real-estate records in the historic-center programme; it is a local records source, not a citywide public vector service.
